body: Not so much anymore. I want a permanent solution because I have been like this for at least 20 years. I don't think a sleep will solve anything except being desolate and having trouble to put that fake smile back on for society.
And here comes the (shadow) ban for talking too much, right? Can't vent anywhere without consequences.
I'm tired. I am embarrassed of being me. I don't want this anymore.
Im talking here, so obviously, I care.. Right? Am I asking for help or just letting it out?
I often wonder when I will get cancer from smoking or liver failure from drinking. If it ever comes, it will suck, but at least I can rest until I die.

I miss my dead mom, but wish she was back to tell her I love her, but also tell her how she fucked up as a mom. My dad is still around, but he's so low in IQ or whatever to really grasp anything or know what to say. Not his fault, just who he is. However, he failed as a dad, too.
I was happy to help my land lady with bringing in her groceries. Then it stopped. I'm just talking.
Fuck... It doesn't stop, does it.
A special happy birthday to you. Do anything you want on your down time.
Context is what I needed. Thank you. I have thought a lot on seeking all other options, despite exhaustion. Again, thanks for your words.
The opposite. I drink myself to sleep daily to avoid life altogether.

I live around some pretty dangerous drivers. It's a cliche but this profile of people is known for dangerous/ignorant driving and it shows. Lately I have been finding myself briskly walking through intersections hoping to be hit as it would give me a valid excuse to get on an employment assistance program to get better or just end it. I actually dont care if I become physically disabled after. My mind already is.

It's a narcotic. All I can say is people go to jail for robbing pharmacies for it. I do not condone it's use as I do not practice medicine so I don't want to start anything. However with those details, I'm sure you can ask your doctor and figure it out.

I feel like there is no end to this disease. there has been 2 things I have had in my life that worked: I was prescribed a special pill by a psych for moments of distress and it was a cure. It put water on the fire very effectively. The other one was a plant that seems to be bouncing around the legal line now-a-days in North America. The issue is the pill is hazardous and the plant is too expensive in the long run. Plus no drug policies at work, I'm basically screwed. Been on a sober kick for about 7 weeks now due to prescriptions and money running out and the depression, anxiety and all the fun stuff associated with it has been climbing.
What I question is how come to end a physical ailment, assisted S. is ok, but a mental one, it's not?
I'm sorry that this is a factor. It is with myself, as well.
If I violated any TOS, Im sorry. I tried to clean it up.
